script_text: Aquarius, stop scrolling, because Uranus has just triggered a profound shift in your first house of identity. As an Air sign, Monday through Wednesday brings a Mars square in your sixth house, creating sudden career friction and delays, yet Venus in Libra conjuncts your seventh house, making Tuesday genuinely ideal for romance. Thursday is the shift: Mercury enters your eighth house of shared resources, moving money talk from your partner directly to your public life. By Friday, a trine from Pluto in your first house empowers a bold financial decision regarding your long-term career path and income. Tuesday is your power day because Venus lights up your seventh house of love and deep commitment. Wednesday is your hardest day due to that aggressive Mars square against your work sector all day. Speak one truth to your partner before bed to heal old resentments. Follow for daily updates.
